Location: Stockholm or Gothenburg (preferred)

Start Date: Late January 2027

Work Model: Hybrid (3 days minimum onsite)

The Challenge Ahead

DICE is a creative studio with offices in Stockholm and Gothenburg. We believe in the power of inclusion and welcome game creators from all backgrounds to collaborate with us as we unlock the potential for the future of Battlefield!

We’re always pushing to be at the forefront of creative entertainment - blending digital art, design, and technology to push boundaries. Our collaborative culture is fueled by passion, driving innovation and making a positive difference for our players and community.

At DICE, your ideas matter. We offer an inclusive space where you can thrive, be yourself, and grow alongside a team dedicated to making a meaningful impact to the world of gaming. We’re all-in on the future and our most ambitious Battlefield yet. Want to be part of something special? Read on.

Responsibilities

We are looking for 2x Master Thesis students to work on our team and go deep in any of a wide range of problem spaces (individuals and pairs). While we welcome a variety of research approaches, we are especially interested in projects that incorporate Generative AI or Machine Learning technologies. If you’re excited about leveraging these transformative techniques to tackle challenges in game development, we would love to hear your ideas!

For this current hiring cycle, we are looking for candidates interested in exploring subjects such as:

Crash Analysis & Grouping: Leverage machine learning and natural language processing pipelines to analyze editor crash data, call stacks, and local log files, automatically grouping crashes with similar technical causes.
Combined Code & Asset: Combine code history with asset and configuration changes in version control to identify the exact combination of changes causing editor issues.
Session Replay & Reproduction: Convert user session telemetry and logs into executable test scripts to automatically reproduce local editor crashes in a headless environment.

An open application means that you can provide ideas for what you want to work on, but we can also explore this together, based on your experiences and interests. If you have a thesis partner in mind, please make sure both of you apply individually and reference your partner's name in your applications.

Eligibility

You are pursuing a MsC. in Computer Science (or similar)
You are associated with a university education or any other type of education in Sweden that has an internship period planned into the education plan.

Skills

You are interested in working in games
You have experience in Unity, Unreal, Maya or Houdini
You have experience in C++ or C#, depending on the topic

Help us make play happen. Apply now with an up-to-date CV and Cover Letter in English, explaining what project you would like to work on and explain your pick based on your interests and skills.

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. jobs.title: Mjukvaruutvecklare / Embedded Software
jobs.description:
Etteplan är ett internationellt teknikkonsultbolag med över 4000 specialister globalt. I Sverige arbetar vi nära våra kunder i tekniskt komplexa, ofta långsiktiga uppdrag där mjukvara är affärskritisk. Vi hjälper marknadsledande industriföretag inom exempelvis flyg, fordon, försvar och industriella system att utveckla robusta och framtidssäkra lösningar – i miljöer där kvalitet, tillförlitlighet och ingenjörsmässighet är avgörande. Hos oss är tekniken avancerad, men samarbetet är prestigelöst. Vi tror på tydlighet, förtroende och på kraften i erfarna team som tar ansvar tillsammans.

Vi samarbetar mellan våra kontor och anställer där kompetensen finns. Därför är du välkommen att söka även om du bor på en annan ort än den som anges i annonsen, förutsatt att du kan arbeta från något av våra kontor.

Din roll

Som Mjukvaruutvecklare / Embedded Software
på Etteplan arbetar du i uppdrag där mjukvaran är en central del av helheten – ofta i system med höga krav på stabilitet, säkerhet och livslängd. Projekten kan omfatta allt från låg- och mellanlagernära utveckling till mer systemövergripande ansvar, beroende på din erfarenhet och kundens behov.

Du arbetar nära andra ingenjörsdiscipliner och har en viktig roll i att omsätta krav till hållbara tekniska lösningar. I många uppdrag förväntas du bidra med mer än bara kod – exempelvis genom tekniska resonemang, struktur, mentorskap eller ett helhetsperspektiv på systemet. För dig som vill finns också möjlighet att ta tekniskt ledande ansvar.

Vi rekryterar till flera av våra kontor runt om i Sverige och arbetar huvudsakligen regionalt, med hybridarbete där uppdraget tillåter.

Din profil

För att kunna möta våra kunders behov ser vi att du:

Har ingenjörsutbildning inom datateknik, inbyggda system, elektronik eller motsvarande
Har 3+ års relevant yrkeserfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling, gärna inom embedded
Har god erfarenhet av C/C++, C#, Python och arbete i Linux‑miljö
Är van att arbeta enligt agila arbetssätt och etablerade utvecklingsprocesser
Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift

Det meriterande om du har erfarenhet eller kunskap inom AI, automatiserade byggen och testning, systemsäkerhet eller functional safety.

Många av våra uppdrag bedrivs i reglerade eller säkerhetsklassade miljöer, vilket ställer krav på struktur, dokumentation och professionell kommunikation. Därför söker vi dig som är trygg i din kompetens, arbetar metodiskt och tar ansvar för kvalitet i leveransen. Tjänsten kan innebära säkerhetsprövning enligt säkerhetsskyddslagstiftning, och för vissa uppdrag krävs svenskt medborgarskap.

Att vara konsult hos Etteplan

Som konsult hos Etteplan får du kombinera stabiliteten hos en etablerad arbetsgivare med variationen i olika uppdrag, tekniker och branscher. Du blir en del av ett erfaret ingenjörsnätverk där kunskapsdelning, långsiktighet och kvalitet står i fokus.

Vi erbjuder

Hos Etteplan erbjuder vi trygga anställningsvillkor med kollektivavtal, tjänstepension, försäkringar, vårdförsäkring och friskvårdsbidrag. Du får en flexibel arbetsmiljö med möjlighet till hybridarbete samt stöd från erfarna kollegor och närvarande konsultchefer. Vi värnar om balans i livet och skapar förutsättningar för både professionell och personlig utveckling.

Ansökan och nästa steg

Ansök genom att ladda upp ditt CV och besvara några korta urvalsfrågor. Processen inleds med en telefonavstämning och följs av samtal med konsultchef och vid behov tekniska kollegor.

jobs.title: Cloud Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Att välja Capgemini innebär att välja en arbetsplats där du ges möjlighet att forma din karriär på det sätt du själv önskar, där du ingår i en stödjande och inspirerande gemenskap med engagerade kollegor världen över, och där du får chansen att omdefiniera vad som är möjligt. Våra Cloud & Custom Applications team fokuserar på att utveckla skräddarsydda, skalbara och säkra cloudapplikationer, integrera IT-system och driva affärstransformation. AI är en nyckelteknologi i allt vi gör och en central del i hur vi formar och bygger moderna system och lösningar, där intelligenta AI-drivna arbetssätt och teknologier som Agentic AI driver utvecklingen framåt. Bli en del av oss och var med och forma framtidens system tillsammans med världsledande organisationer och bidra till att frigöra teknikens fulla potential i en mer hållbar och inkluderande värld!

Om rollen

Är du passionerad kring allt som rör molnet? Vi söker just nu en erfaren Cloud Solution Architect till vårt Architecture & BA-team i Malmö/Helsingborg. Teamet fokuserar på arkitektur, utveckling samt att bygga lösningar och tjänster på två av de största molnplattformarna – AWS och GCP. Du kommer att arbeta med kunduppdrag i Skåne-regionen, men som en del av Capgeminis globala organisation får du även möjlighet att samarbeta, utvecklas och växa tillsammans med kollegor världen över.

Teamet arbetar med att skapa moderna, skalbara och hållbara lösningar i molnet – alltid med kundens affär i fokus. Med både bredd och djup erbjuder vi fantastiska möjligheter att förädla dina arkitekturfärdigheter, dela kunskap och utveckla dig tillsammans med skickliga kollegor i teamet.

I den här rollen kommer du att ha en nyckelroll i:

Arbeta med applikationsdesign och arkitektur i molnmiljöer
Integrationer för molnbaserade tjänster
Cloud DevOps och DevSecOps samt Lösningsarkitektur
DevOps verktyg; Git, Docker, Maven, Kubernetes

Din profil

+5 års erfarenhet av utveckling i tekniker så som Java, J2EE, Node.js, och React
Du har hands on erfarenhet inom AWS eller GCP och kan bevisa det med motsvarande certifiering
Goda kunskaper av Mikrotjänster - Utveckling och distribution av mikrotjänster i molnet inklusive containerisering, orkestrering och infrastruktur som kod med hjälp av Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, BlackDuck, samt +2 års dokumenterade erfarenhet av att designa/implementera AI/ML-lösningar, med fokus på maskininlärning, djupinlärning, NLP och GenAI
Du skriver och talar flytande svenska då det används i det dagliga arbetet

Meriterande

Back-end erfarenhet inom följande: Python, TypeScript eller liknande
Front-end erfarenhet inom följande: Angular, Vue.js eller Jquery

Vad vi tror kommer få dig att trivas

Arbeta med de senaste teknologierna och påverka på nordisk nivå. Du samarbetar med andra specialister, kompetensväxlar och bidrar till att bygga AWS/GCP-kapabilitet i Norden – samtidigt som du påverkar några av världens största bolag.
Utvecklas genom utbildningar, certifieringar och interna initiativ. Du får tillgång till utbildningar och certifieringar inom AI, AWS/GCP och Microsoft Azure, samt möjlighet att engagera dig i Capgeminis fokusområden som Diversity & Inclusion, Sustainability, Wellness Club och Art Club.
Njut av en engagerande arbetsplats med starkt stöd och förmåner. Vi erbjuder friskvårdsbidrag, tjänstepension, bonusprogram, företagshälsovård och sjukvårdsförsäkring samt en inkluderande kontorskultur med sociala aktiviteter och teambuilding.

Ansökan

Redo att ta din karriär till nästa nivå? Vi ser fram emot din ansökan och återkommer till dig så snart som möjligt.

Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess kommer identitetskontroll att genomföras genom granskning av ditt ID-kort, och bakgrundskontroller kan utföras vid behov.

Om Capgemini

Capgemini är en AI-driven global partner för affärs- och tekniktransformation som levererar konkret verksamhetsnytta. Vi formar framtiden för organisationer och förverkligar den med hjälp av AI, teknik och människor. Med vår starka historia på nästan 60 år är vi en ansvarsfull och mångsidig koncern med över 420 000 medarbetare i över 50 länder. Genom vår expertis inom strategi, teknik, design, ingenjörstjänster och affärsverksamhet levererar vi heltäckande tjänster och lösningar, baserade på vår djupa branschkunskap och vårt omfattande partnernätverk. Koncernen rapporterade globala intäkter på 22,5 miljarder euro för 2025.

Personvern og sekundærbruk

jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior Platform Engineer
– Public 360° – Tieto Indtech (m/f/d)

Tieto Public 360° – building secure, scalable digital services for the public sector across the Nordics.

About The Company

Tieto's Public 360° is a leading case management platform used across the Nordic public sector for over 20 years. Since 2014, the SaaS platform has been running on modernized Azure infrastructure with automated deployments while also supporting on-prem/hybrid/Domestic cloud installations.

The 360° platform currently powers three solutions:

Public 360° – Case and archive management

Plan & Build 360° – Building permit applications

eArchive 360° – Long-term data storage

The challenge

We're building on Public 360°'s modern foundation to expand across multiple cloud environments—strengthening Nordic digital sovereignty and enabling AI capabilities, all while maintaining the highest requirements for security and compliance.

The role

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you'll advance the technical capabilities of the 360° hosting platform. You'll design and operate cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, automation, and security systems that support continued growth and enable new AI-powered features.

Key Responsibilities

Build and operate the cloud platform foundation supporting Public 360° across Public Cloud and Domestic Cloud environments.
Deploy, manage, and continuously improve Kubernetes-based platforms and containerized workloads.
Drive automation through Infrastructure as Code (Bicep), GitOps, CI/CD, and self-service platform capabilities.
Establish secure and scalable platform services covering networking, identity, secrets management, monitoring, and operational governance.
Improve reliability and operational excellence through observability, automation, incident management, and best practices.
Support the modernization of Public 360° through cloud-native technologies, APIs, messaging, and microservices architectures.

Required Qualifications

Several years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar roles.
Strong Azure and cloud-native platform experience.
Strong hands-on Kubernetes experience, including:
Cluster deployment, installation, and lifecycle management.
Operations, upgrades, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
Networking, security, and scalability.
Experience operating Kubernetes in cloud, on-premises, or domestic cloud environments.

Experience with Microsoft Azure services, particularly AKS, cloud networking, security monitoring, logging, and observability platforms.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform or similar), GitOps, and CI/CD using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with sovereign, domestic cloud, hybrid cloud, or other highly regulated environments.
Familiarity with messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Azure Service Bus.
Experience with Keycloak or other identity and access management platforms.
Experience operating distributed systems, microservices architectures, or multi-region Kubernetes environments.
Exposure to AI platform infrastructure, intelligent automation, or GenAI technologies.

Tech we use

We are Azure-first and automation-driven, building and operating our platform using Kubernetes (AKS), Docker, containers, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code with Bicep. Our engineering teams use Azure DevOps and GitHub Workflows for CI/CD and automation, supported by Azure networking and cloud security services. We focus heavily on observability and reliability, using Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, and Alloy for monitoring and telemetry. Authentication and authorization are managed through Keycloak, while RabbitMQ provides messaging capabilities across our platform. Our API and ingress layer is built on technologies such as APISIX and NGINX, with certificate management handled through OpenBao and cert-manager. Development is primarily done using .NET (C#), TypeScript/JavaScript, PowerShell, and Bash, with Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code as our primary development tools.

Why join us

Build technology that improves citizen services across the Nordic public sector.
Work with modern cloud technologies and large-scale enterprise software.
Join a highly skilled and collaborative engineering environment with significant influence on technical decisions.
Opportunity to shape the future platform capabilities supporting Public 360°.
Professional growth through international collaboration, technical leadership opportunities, and continuous learning.
A culture built on trust, transparency, ownership, and innovation.

Practicalities

Location and work setup:
Flexible/hybrid, ideally near one of our development hubs in Scandinavia (Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, or Espoo).

Language requirements:
Fluent English required. Nordic language skills are considered an advantage.

Are you our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today.

If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring managers Ida Sirevaag
(ida.sirevaag@tieto.com) or Geir Are Bjørnsrud
(geirare.bjornsrud@tieto.com).

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

jobs.title: Sr Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?

At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.

Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.

Summary

At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.

Sequencing has moved genomics from single studies to population scale. Multi-million-sample cohorts, linked phenotypes and multi-omic data are now generated faster than most organizations can analyze them. Our team builds the data platform and the analytical applications that turn these assets into products: a cloud-native lakehouse for genomic and phenotypic data, large-scale statistical genetics pipelines that run reliably at population scale, and the APIs and user interfaces that let scientists ask questions of billions of records and get answers in seconds.

We are looking for a Sr. Staff Software Engineer for this effort in Singapore: someone who can take state-of-the-art analytical methods and turn them into scalable, high-performance, commercial software, and who can work fluently across bioinformatics scientists, cloud infrastructure engineers, and product management. You will work with a globally distributed team, prototyping quickly, demonstrating early, and iterating toward a releasable product.

Responsibilities

Turn advanced statistical genetics methods (for example, genome-wide and phenome-wide association testing for both common and rare variants) from prototypes into high-performance, scientifically accurate, commercially releasable products.
Design and implement analysis pipelines that scale to millions of samples on a cloud-native lakehouse, and establish the standardized, reusable design pattern for low-latency analysis on open table formats at petabyte scale.
Deliver the APIs, web UI and natural-language/agentic query interfaces through which scientific users explore association results and cohort/phenotype data interactively at scale.
Own the operability and unit economics of the platform: orchestrate, monitor, debug and cost-optimize workloads spanning millions of concurrent jobs, designing for fault tolerance and reproducible results.
Partner with bioinformatics scientists, cloud infrastructure teams and product management to translate scientific and customer needs into a product architecture and credible delivery plan aligned with the platform and data business strategy, applying a clear view of what distinguishes a commercial-grade offering from research and open-source community tooling.
Set technical direction and raise engineering standards through design review, mentorship and hands-on contribution, prototyping and iterating rapidly with a customer-first mindset across a globally distributed team.

Requirements

Degree in Computer Science / Engineering / Bioinformatics / Mathematics or a related field.
Demonstrated experience designing and delivering large-scale, data-analysis production software in the cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including containerization (Docker), orchestration, infrastructure automation, and CI/CD.
Strong experience with modern data lake / lakehouse architectures, including open table format internals rather than usage alone: Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake table specifications, catalog services, snapshot lifecycle, partitioning and pruning strategy, compaction, and schema evolution, over columnar storage (Parquet) with distributed query engines (for example Spark, Trino, Databricks).
Solid algorithms and systems engineering foundation, with proven ability to implement performance-critical code in a compiled language such as C/C++, including concurrency, memory management, vectorization and SIMD, and work with columnar in-memory formats and vectorized engines such as Apache Arrow, DuckDB, or Velox.
Proven track record of profiling and optimizing end-to-end systems for runtime, memory, I/O and cloud cost at large scale, and of designing for horizontal scalability.
Proficiency in Python for rapid prototyping, data analysis, and productionized tooling, with familiarity with the scientific and ML/DL library ecosystem.
Experience designing and operating distributed batch and workflow systems that manage very large numbers of concurrent jobs, including metrics, tracing and structured logging, retry, checkpointing and idempotency, and failure triage at million-task scale.
Experience with scientific workflow languages and engines (for example Nextflow, WDL, CWL) and with execution on cloud batch or Kubernetes.
Experience designing and delivering service APIs with an API-first approach: REST or gRPC interface design, versioning and backward compatibility, and multi-tenant access patterns; plus enough full-stack fluency to partner on (or build) modern web front ends and to hold strong opinions on UI/UX for data-heavy scientific applications.
Experience validating numerically and statistically sensitive software: concordance testing against reference implementations, calibration checks, benchmark suites, versioned reference data, and end-to-end reproducibility.
Proven technical leadership and influence at senior level, with strong verbal and written communication skills, and the ability to self-manage and manage interdisciplinary relationships.
Demonstrated experience using AI tooling to plan, manage and accelerate the full software development lifecycle, and to materially increase engineering productivity and quality.

Experience / Education

Sr. Staff Software Engineer: Typically requires a minimum of 12 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 8 years and a Master's degree; or a PhD with 5 years experience; or equivalent experience.

Desired

Working knowledge of statistical genetics and population genomics: genome-wide and phenome-wide association studies, common and rare variant analysis (including gene-based burden and aggregate tests), mixed-model and whole-genome regression approaches, and the standard data formats and quality control practices of the field (VCF/gVCF, PLINK, BGEN, summary statistics, cohort and phenotype definition, ancestry and relatedness handling).
Hands-on experience with genomics-native storage and query stacks such as TileDB / TileDB-VCF, Hail, GLOW, or GenomicsDB.
Experience delivering commercial or clinical-grade genomics or life-science data products, including taking an internal or research tool through to a commercially released product, and a clear understanding of the differences in philosophy, obligations and trade-offs between commercial productization and academic, non-profit or research-community tooling.
Familiarity with techniques for low-latency query over very large result sets: precomputed summary indices, bitmap and zone maps, sketching, and tiered materialization.
Experience building agentic workflows and products, including tool/agent orchestration and MCP-style integrations, over enterprise data; and with machine learning, deep learning or foundation model training applied to genomic or biomedical data.
Experience implementing data governance controls: role-based and row/column-level access, audit trails, tenant isolation, and consent-driven restrictions on data use.
Experience with interactive data visualization for very large result sets, and with modern front-end frameworks.
Cloud cost engineering: cost-per-analysis modelling, spot and preemptible capacity strategy, storage tiering, and egress management.
Be curious, detail oriented, and analytical, with a proven ability to learn quickly.
Be customer-focused, team-oriented, and motivated, taking ownership of assigned tasks and of ambiguous problems.

Listed responsibilities are an essential, but not exhaustive, list of the usual duties associated with the position. Changes to individual responsibilities may occur due to business needs.

nShift
is the leading global provider of cloud delivery management solutions (SaaS), we enable the frictionless shipment and return of almost one billion shipments across 190 countries each year. About You

You're an engineering leader who still enjoys being close to the code. You care about your people as much as about the product, and you're comfortable balancing delivery, quality, and team growth.

You are someone who:

Builds and leads a high-performing team of developers and testers, with clear expectations and regular feedback
Knows the status of every commitment the team has made, and acts early when something slips
Holds a high bar for the team's work and your own, raised through clear expectations and direct feedback
Communicates openly and clearly with the team, stakeholders, and management, including when the message is difficult

Communicating company goals and representing the team within the organization
Owning delivery predictability and the team's say/do ratio, alongside technical excellence

Technology

Take part in design and architecture discussions, and review code regularly enough to have an informed view of quality and risk.
Challenge estimates and technical approaches, drawing on your own engineering experience.

Create opportunities for team members to stay motivated through mentorship, coaching, or delegating tasks to encourage professional growth.
Set clear expectations for each engineer and manage performance against them, setting an example for your team to follow.

About Infiterra

Join our mission to grow and transform the subscription economy by simplifying subscription service delivery.

Infiterra
enables IT distributors, Managed Service Providers (MSPs), and telcos to succeed in the subscription economy. Our subscription commerce platform automates and unifies subscription workflows - from quote to bill- driving operational efficiency, billing accuracy, and scalable growth.

Recognized as a global leader in subscription commerce, Infiterra combines innovation, performance excellence, and trusted expertise to help partners transform and grow.

Join Infiterra and help power the future of subscription e-commerce.

Infiterra’s B2B SaaS platform helps IT Distributors and Managed Service Providers (MSPs) automate and grow their subscription business. With 100+ customers in 75 countries, we're recognized for innovation and global impact—and we’re just getting started. We foster a collaborative and growth-oriented culture, allowing you to be part of a dynamic, forward-thinking team.

The role in a nutshell 🔍

As a .NET Software Engineer, you'll be part of our agile team, working in the Scrum framework to deliver new features and improve existing ones in our subscription e-commerce platform, the multi-tenant B2B engine that powers global distributors. You'll own whole features within a product domain, from design to production, and work alongside experienced engineers who'll support your growth. From building scalable services to integrating major Software Vendors with our platform, your work will directly shape what our customers use every day.

🎯 Your goal?

To design and deliver reliable, well-tested features that simplify subscription services delivery, following our coding and architectural standards.

You'll be hands-on with .NET (legacy full .NET Framework 4.8 and .NET 10 (latest)), C#, SQL, and domain and service-oriented approaches. You'll work closely with POs, BAs, QA, and DevOps in an agile environment, so that features are delivered smoothly and predictably.

You won’t just code features. You'll own your features end-to-end: design, build, test, release, and keep them healthy in production.

🙋‍♀️ Our Ideal Candidate Profile

You’re a curious and analytical engineer who sees the big picture but sweats the details. You enjoy diving into system architecture, making thoughtful trade-offs, and writing clean, testable code.

You thrive in a fast-paced environment where innovation meets stability. You’re not just a builder. You’re a problem solver who looks for ways to make systems more efficient, scalable, and maintainable.

You value teamwork and knowledge-sharing, but you’re also confident in owning features independently. You’re someone who wants to grow while helping the team grow.

Why You’ll Love It Here 💙

Work on a platform that directly impacts customers across 75+ countries.
Hands-on exposure to APIs, billing systems, and large-scale/high-traffic B2B commerce.
A collaborative engineering culture with peer-led code reviews and knowledge-sharing.
Opportunities to shape system architecture and technical direction.
Friendly, dynamic team with room to grow and learn.
Remote-first: work from anywhere, with optional, ad hoc in-person meet-ups arranged around team members' availability.

What You'll Do

Feature Ownership: Own the end-to-end delivery of whole features within a domain, designing and delivering them independently to our coding and architectural standards.
Technical Debt: Manage your own technical debt through refactoring.
Automated Testing: Write robust automated tests.
Code Reviews: Review your peers' pull requests.
Observability: Build observability into your features, with guidance from DevOps.
Dependencies: Surface cross-team dependencies early.
Clear Communication: Explain technical trade-offs clearly to Product and Quality.
AI-assisted Engineering: Use approved AI tools across implementation, testing, debugging and refactoring, while remaining accountable for correctness and maintainability.

Success looks like: predictable delivery, stable production, more tech debt paid down than introduced in your area, and low escaped defects and rework on the changes you own. All of this comes from strong feature ownership, systems thinking, valuable code-review contributions and dependability.

What You'll Bring

Hands-on .NET engineering experience, typically gained over 3+ years of professional work. We look for proven depth rather than years alone, and assess this case by case.
Experience with .NET Framework 4.8 and/or .NET 10, and C#.
Solid experience with distributed systems and relational databases (SQL Server: queries, stored procedures, performance basics).
Good understanding of HTTP, JSON, and RESTful API principles.
Hands-on experience with test automation (unit and integration testing).
Comfortable working in a CI/CD toolchain (e.g. Azure DevOps).
Understanding of SOLID principles and design patterns, and the ability to apply them where appropriate.
Experience using AI-assisted coding tools responsibly, with the habit of checking what they produce.
Commitment to knowledge-sharing and collaborative teamwork.
University degree in Computer Science or any related field.
Fluency in the Greek and English languages, both oral and written.

About us

Founded in 2015 in Athens, Greece, Welcome redefines the way people travel by going above and beyond the commoditized transfer service and being the first company to deliver a complete, personalised, in-destination travel experience. From the moment a traveler arrives at a new destination, until their return journey home, Welcome accommodates all their travel needs, including transfers, sightseeing trips, and local information, in the easiest, friendliest, and most personalised way possible. Welcome's drivers are experts in the area and share their local know-how to make travellers feel at home wherever they are. The company has also introduced contactless rides, thorough cleaning protocols, and protective equipment to make every journey safe.
Being a travel tech startup, Welcome continues to grow and scale its operations and is quickly becoming a global category leader for in-destination travel services.
One of the highest-rated global transportation companies with a rating of 4.9/5 stars.
Expanded from 200 destinations last year to 350, achieving our ambitious 2024 growth target.
Over 4,000 travel partners including 2,500 hotels, numerous vacation rentals, and travel agents, adding 50+ new ones every month.
Over 2.5 million happy travellers every year.

⭐️ If you want to dive deeper into the awesomeness of Welcome's culture, click
on this link
 to check our TikTok account.⭐️

The Team

We are a group of vibrant, diverse people who love travelling and never settle on quality. Each one of us didn't join Welcome by chance and believes deeply in what Welcome is trying to achieve, so we work relentlessly to make that happen. We challenge common logic, focus on design, put simplicity and usability first, and create memorable experiences. We keep learning and exploring better ways to serve our community and grow personally and professionally in our respective fields. We stay humble along the way, with a "pay it forward" mentality, but with big and bold goals.
As a Senior Platform Engineer
at Welcome Pickups ,
you will keep the platform behind our product reliable, fast, scalable and secure, so travellers, drivers and partners can count on our services every day. Much of what we do runs in the background: matching rides to drivers, pricing, notifications, partner syncs and payouts. If the platform slows down or stops, rides don't get assigned and travellers end up waiting at arrivals. This is a hands-on role that works across all our product teams. You will make key architecture and infrastructure decisions, set the standards everyone builds to, and own the technical roadmap together with the Product Manager of the Core team. The role is about helping product teams move fast without breaking things, not slowing them down.
What you'll work with

A large, fast-growing PostgreSQL/PostGIS database, plus Elasticsearch and Redis
Azure as our main cloud, with AWS S3 and Google Cloud

Reliability & Uptime

Set up and run the incident process and on-call, and reduce recovery times.
Improve monitoring and alerting across the platform (New Relic, Rollbar).

Performance, Scalability & Data

Lead architecture decisions for scaling our backend systems and services.
Find and fix performance bottlenecks across the application, background jobs and database.
Improve the performance of our large, fast-growing PostgreSQL database:
tune slow queries and indexes
plan data growth and archiving
manage replication, backups and restore drills
change large tables without downtime

Make sure the platform handles peak season and partner growth smoothly.

Infrastructure, Security & Compliance

Define and evolve our infrastructure strategy on Azure, and balance performance, reliability and cost.
Define and enforce security best practices: access control, secrets management, and the security of our build and release pipeline.
Prepare the platform for compliance: payment-data rules (PCI), GDPR, and over time SOC 2 / ISO 27001.

Developer Experience

Improve internal tooling, CI/CD and deployment workflows so engineers can ship faster and safer.

Technical Roadmap & Collaboration

Keep the backlog of technical work (upgrades, technical debt, performance, security) organised and ranked in Jira, and prioritise it together with the Product Manager.

BS/MS degree in Computer Science or a related subject.
Proven experience operating and scaling production systems.

Technical Skills
Strong understanding of system design, distributed systems and performance trade-offs.

Take your software engineering career to the next level as a Senior Product Software Engineer. You will play a key role in designing, developing, and troubleshooting software programs. Responsibilities:

Software Development: Participate in designing, developing, and maintaining complex software applications to meet project requirements.
Design Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define design specifications and details, taking into account diverse perspectives.
Effective Communication: Regularly communicate project updates, progress, and challenges to stakeholders and team members.
Technical Documentation: Prepare detailed technical specifications and requirements documents to guide the development process.
Performance Optimization: Identify bottlenecks and optimize software programs to improve overall performance and efficiency.
Application Design: Participate in the design of innovative and user-friendly software applications that align with customer needs and industry standards.
Testing Strategies: Create comprehensive testing routines and procedures to ensure the reliability and accuracy of software applications.
Applied Problem Solving: Utilize mathematical principles and statistical approaches to solve intricate problems in scientific or applied fields within software projects.
Issue Resolution: Collaborate with others to troubleshoot and resolve complex information technology issues that may arise during development.
Data Preparation: Prepare and preprocess data for analysis, ensuring its accuracy and readiness for use in software applications.
Technical Support: Provide technical support to end-users, including assistance with software maintenance, troubleshooting, and usage queries.

Skills:

Software Engineering: The ability to design, develop, and maintain software systems and applications by applying principles and techniques of computer science, engineering, and mathematical analysis. This includes the capacity to understand user requirements, create and test the software, and resolve any software-related issues.
Software Development: The ability to design, write, test, and implement software programs, applications, and systems. This includes understanding various programming languages, software architecture, and software testing methods. It also involves problem-solving capabilities to fix software issues and improve functionality.
Programming: The ability to design, write, test, debug, and maintain the instructions, also known as code, that a computer must follow to execute a task. This skill often involves various programming languages such as C# and Angular.
Problem Solving: The ability to understand a complex situation or issue and devise a solution by defining the problem, identifying potential strategies, and ultimately choosing and implementing the most effective course of action.
Analysis: The ability to examine complex situations or problems, break them down into smaller parts, and understand how these parts work together.
Testing: The skill of evaluating a system or process, often in software or product development. It involves the ability to identify problems, measure effectiveness, and ensure quality or functionality.
Agile: The ability to swiftly and effectively respond to changes, with an emphasis on continuous improvement and flexibility. In the context of project management, it denotes a methodology that promotes adaptive planning and encourages rapid and flexible responses to changes.
Source Code Repository: The ability to effectively use a source code repository, a file archive, and a web hosting facility where a large amount of source code, for software or for web pages, is kept, either publicly or privately. This skill involves the ability to manage and track changes to code, identify and fix issues, merge code from different branches, and collaborate with other developers.
Non-Relational Database: The ability to design, implement, and manipulate a non-relational database (MongoDB).
APIs: The ability to design, develop, and manage Application Programming Interfaces, which constitute the set of protocols and tools used for building application software. This skill includes the capacity to create and maintain high-quality API documentation, implement API security practices, and understand API testing techniques. Additionally, having this ability means understanding how APIs enable interaction between different software systems, allowing them to communicate with each other.
Design: The ability to create, conceptualize, sketch, and implement layouts, structures, and plans either for aesthetic or functional purposes. This could be used in various contexts such as architecture, fashion, graphics, interior, and more. It involves creativity, problem-solving, and strategic thinking.
Framework: The ability to understand, utilize, design, and develop complex structures and systems in various contexts such as programming, project management, or business strategy. This ability requires critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
Documentation: The ability to create, manage, organize, and maintain important information and documents in various physical and digital formats. This skill may include preparing reports, managing files, storing data, and keeping records organized and updated for easy retrieval and understanding.
Advanced Technology Adoption and Utilization: AI Tool Proficiency: Evaluate and optimize AI tool usage for team efficiency and productivity; AI Output Validation: Establish validation standards and review processes for AI-generated code; Responsible AI Usage: Lead responsible AI initiatives and establish team best practices; and Agentic Workflow Design: Design and optimize AI agent workflows for team efficiency.

Analytical Skills
Inclusive Collaboration
Drive to Perform

jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description:
At Materialise Medical, we believe that better healthcare starts with solutions designed around the individual patient. If you’re passionate about bringing personalized care to every patient, you’ll love being a part of this team. Through the technology we develop, researchers, engineers, and clinicians are revolutionizing personalized treatment — helping improve and save lives daily.

Mimics Flow is our innovative case management solution designed to streamline personalized patient care. By providing full visibility and control over every step of the workflow—from request to approval—Mimics Flow empowers surgeons and hospitals to deliver high-quality results while ensuring seamless compliance with local regulations.

As part of the Mimics Flow platform, you will play a key role in shaping the architecture of our new service, Mimics Workflow, a standalone product that integrates seamlessly into the platform. We are looking for a  Software Architect
 who combines technical expertise with strategic vision and exceptional communication skills to ensure the success of this new service and its alignment with our mission.

What You Will Do

Define and manage the architecture of one or more applications in the Mimics Flow platform.
Provide implementation strategies, work decomposition, and technology recommendations.
Serve as the technical and architectural point of contact for your team, sharing best practices and mentoring team members.
Collaborate with product management, stakeholders, and other teams to define and defend the technical roadmap.
Represent your team in the Materialise group of architects to align solutions across departments.
Maintain architecture documentation and contribute to cloud-related initiatives.
Actively participate in agile ceremonies, such as sprint planning and backlog refinement.

Your Profile

Technical Skills

You have experience with/working knowledge of: .NET Core, ASP.NET, Entity Framework, and Automapper. Designing modern cloud-native applications, including Docker, Kubernetes, microservices, and DevOps practices. Cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) and related tools, such as Kubernetes, Docker, and Amazon Storage. Walking up the cloud stack (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) using modern terminology and relevance. Designing and developing integrations and interactions with other systems and applications.
You are familiar with networking technologies and DevOps tools related to software solution design, including REST, gRPC, GraphQL, and Terraform.
You are familiar with front-end technologies, such as TypeScript, NodeJS, and React.
Knowledge of BPMN (Business Process Model and Notation) is a plus.

Soft Skills

Excellent communication and presentation skills in English, with the ability to clearly explain complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.
Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with product management, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.
Confidence in negotiating and defending architectural decisions and technical roadmaps.
A proactive mentor who shares best practices and inspires the team toward technical excellence.

Mindset and Culture Fit

A strategic thinker with a helicopter view, capable of aligning technical solutions with business priorities and long-term goals.
Familiarity with agile working methods (Scrum, Kanban) and enthusiasm for contributing to a self-organizing team.
Passion for Materialise’s mission to scale additive manufacturing across industries, from aerospace to medical, and drive Industry 4.0.

What’s Waiting For You

Work that matters

The technology we build at Materialise pushes the boundaries. You’ll find pride in building something that matters, whether you designed it, printed it, or shipped it. No matter your role, we unlock new possibilities to build a better and healthier world every day.

At Materialise, we expect you to think about the customer, not just the task. You push for better solutions and care about the difference your work makes.

A people-centered space

When you join Materialise, you join a group of colleagues invested in you, not just your work. From your own team to a department across the world, you’ll find a sense of belonging with people who help without being asked, challenge you, and have your back.

At the same time, we expect you to invest in the people around you — not just your own work — to make the group stronger than the sum of its parts.

An environment of trust

As a company of innovators, we know how crucial autonomy is in your work. When we hire you, we trust in your expertise, giving you space to organize your tasks, work flexibly, and make your own calls.

At Materialise, we expect you to deliver on that trust and keep your commitments.

A career ready to build

When you see opportunities for your career to grow at Materialise, we encourage you to go for them. People shape a fulfilling career at their own pace here.

At Materialise, we expect you to take initiative in your own development. Don’t wait for someone else to plan your career. Step into the space and make it count.

Make a difference together with the Medical team.

Company Description

Creating a future worth living for future generations gets us out of bed every morning. Depending on the project, we are consultants, implementers, or both for sustainable, innovative and economical solutions for real estate, industry, energy and infrastructure. Our more than 6,500 employees at over 80 locations worldwide support our customers in interdisciplinary teams. Our thinking is both visionary and realistic. We work independently and as part of a team. With passion and the latest technologies. We unite. Join us at Dreso and let’s create a world we want to live in.

Job Description

We help our clients turn data into measurable value. From data platforms and analytics to AI-powered applications, we develop smart solutions for complex projects across industry, real estate, and infrastructure.

As a Solution Engineer
, you play a key role at the interface between our clients, solution architects, and product developers. You translate business needs into viable data and AI solutions, guide their implementation, and make sure they deliver real value in client projects.

Your Responsibilities

Act as the trusted point of contact for clients on Smart, Data & AI topics, from first needs assessment through to solution rollout.
Analyze business processes and translate client requirements into functional and technical requirements, use cases, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
Work with solution architects to design data architectures, data models, analytics solutions, and AI use cases that fit the client's context.
Support the implementation of data, analytics, and AI solutions together with developers, architects, and data engineers.
Assess requirements against existing standard solutions, configuration options, and the need for new development.
Plan and facilitate workshops, demos, user acceptance tests, and solution validations with clients and project teams.
Support clients with adoption, training, and change management activities and feed project learnings back into solution development.
Communicate complex technical and analytical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of Smart, Data & AI offerings, methodologies, and best practices.
Take ownership beyond advisory services by actively leading and supporting the delivery and deployment of solutions, ensuring concepts are successfully translated into operational outcomes for clients.

Qualifications

Completed degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a comparable qualification.
At least 5 years of professional experience in consulting, business analysis, solution engineering, or solution design within data, analytics, or AI-related projects.
Proven experience working in a client-facing role between business stakeholders and technical teams.
Strong understanding of data platforms, data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, analytics solutions, BI concepts, and the fundamentals of machine learning and generative AI.
Experience in requirements engineering, process analysis, user stories, acceptance criteria, and workshop facilitation.
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Understanding of data governance, security, roles, and permission concepts.
Hands-on experience with Python, SQL, data analysis, or AI technologies is considered a strong advantage.
Strong analytical thinking, a structured approach to problem-solving, and the confidence to challenge requirements constructively.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in English and German.

Additional Information

To ensure your work-life balance, we offer the option of mobile working
We promote your professional and personal development through individual training and further education at the Drees & Sommer Academy
We support your health with a bonus for sports enthusiasts. We offer the possibility of subscribing to a private health insurance policy
Employees benefit from tax advantages related to their commuting expenses for the office
Fiscal advantages for employees expenses in meal costs during worktime. Employee referral program with attractive bonus scheme
Supporting career and family by receiving tax benefits for kindergarten expenses

jobs.description:
Junior NetSuite Developer Role Description

This is a full-time, fully remote role for a Junior Developer at MindCloud, an Oracle NetSuite Alliance Partner. You'll support the configuration, customisation, and maintenance of NetSuite solutions for our clients and internal products, working alongside senior developers who'll mentor you from day one.

Your work will span scripting, workflows, and integrations. As well as core NetSuite development, MindCloud builds AI-powered products on top of the platform — including tools that use large language model APIs to automate document processing — so there's real scope to grow into modern web and AI development as you progress. Day to day, you'll help build and modify SuiteScript customisations, troubleshoot system issues, implement enhancements, prepare technical documentation, and take part in testing and deployment.

You'll collaborate closely with consultants, project managers, and end users to understand business requirements and translate them into clean, practical technical solutions. We invest heavily in development: through MindCloud Academy you'll receive structured training, certification support, and continuous mentoring on your way to becoming a skilled NetSuite developer.

What You'll Do

Assist in developing and modifying SuiteScript (JavaScript-based) customisations, workflows, and integrations under the guidance of senior developers.
Build and maintain custom records, fields, forms, roles, and workflows in NetSuite.
Support the development of integrations between NetSuite and external systems and APIs.
Contribute to MindCloud's AI-powered products, including features built on large language model APIs.
Troubleshoot and debug functional and technical issues, and implement small enhancements.
Prepare technical documentation and participate in testing and deployment.
Learn and apply NetSuite development best practices, with openness to feedback and code review.

What We're Looking For

Knowledge of programming fundamentals and at least one scripting language —  JavaScript preferred
, as SuiteScript is JavaScript-based.
Familiarity with web technologies such as  HTML, CSS, and working with REST APIs / JSON
.
Interest in  AI and large language models
, and curiosity about applying them to real business problems (hands-on experience is a plus, not a requirement).
Ability to understand business processes in accounting, finance, or operations and translate requirements into technical specifications.
Foundational exposure to software testing, debugging, and documentation.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organisational skills, with attention to detail.
Effective written and verbal communication, and the ability to collaborate with a remote, cross-functional team.
Motivation to learn NetSuite and cloud ERP technologies, with openness to mentoring.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have

Exposure to SuiteScript, SuiteFlow, or other ERP scripting tools.
Experience with Node.js, Python, or building/consuming APIs.
Any project — academic, personal, or professional — involving AI, automation, or web development.
Prior exposure to ERP systems, SaaS products, or business applications.

What You'll Get

Comprehensive onboarding through MindCloud Academy.
Structured NetSuite training and certification support.
Continuous mentoring from experienced developers and consultants.
Hands-on experience on real client projects and on MindCloud's own AI products.
A collaborative, supportive, fully remote working environment.
Clear career progression towards Developer and Senior Developer roles.

In addition, we provide products and services to protect life’s other most important assets: our homes and digital identities. Our 6,500 team members foster an uncommon, innovative culture and are dedicated to successfully bringing the future to bear today through cognitive answers, insights, algorithms and automation. For more information, please visit solera.com.

The Role

The Senior Engineer role will play a crucial part in Solera’s day-to-day operations and initiatives. The successful candidate will possess a deep level of technical experience surrounding identity and access management, focused on production application services support, including Windows and Linux Operating systems, and various proprietary software platforms. While the role is very certainly one that centralizes around management, deep technical experience, and repeated examples of success in a senior level technical position are required for success.

What You’ll Do

Work on a support team supporting application products gobally.

Responsible for the monitoring, measuring, performance, availability, security, recovery, and throughput of application services.

Provide 24x7 On-call support on a rotational basis and effectively diagnose / triage / fix systems during outages.

Ensure design, infrastructure, process/operational documentation is up-to-date.

Facilitate production deployments.

What You’ll Bring

A passion for excellence in delivery of service to customers and colleagues alike

A drive to improve operational processes and procedures.

Strong familiarity with broad range of technologies: Windows/Linux, multi-tier web applications, middleware (web/app servers, containers, message queues, etc), containers, databases, networking, Citrix/VDI, etc

Strong affinity to automate repetitive tasks, leaning out processes that drive down outages and deliver quick results.

Familiarity with Public & Private Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), VMware virtualized systems environments.

Knowledgeable of source control management and CI/CD.

Good understanding of application architecture, databases, knowledge of java, .net, python preferred.

Networking architecture understanding (F5, haproxy)

Solera is a global leader in data and software services that strives to transform every touchpoint of the vehicle lifecycle into a connected digital experience. In addition, we provide products and services to protect life’s other most important assets: our homes and digital identities. Today, Solera processes over 300 million digital transactions annually for approximately 235,000 partners and customers in more than 90 countries. Our 6,500 team members foster an uncommon, innovative culture and are dedicated to successfully bringing the future to bear today through cognitive answers, insights, algorithms and automation. For more information, please visit solera.com.

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Software Development Manager who can act as a strong leader and provide guidance to multiple squads of Software Development Engineers. Our Manager will have a passion for building complex web and enterprise applications. As the leader of the squads, you will be creating clear objectives and deliverables with an emphasis on scalability, maintainability, security, and performance. Solera needs a leader that can ensure high-quality applications and on-time delivery of software that supports our growing business. Our innovative leader will work in an Agile environment that mentors and fosters team collaboration.

What You’ll Do

Lead multiple software development squads toward the best technical solution for functionalities required within the product.
Define expectations and develop metrics to monitor results.
Troubleshoot and resolve the team’s technical impediments.
Provide leadership, direction, and guidance to the team.
Coach, train and provide regular feedback to the team.
Coordinate with other Dev Managers and the Architecture Team when defining new designs and solutions.
Suggest initiatives to improve current processes and technologies.
Analyze system specifications and translate system requirements to manageable & measurable tasks
Identify and correct code smells, eliminate bugs and fix technical bottlenecks
Help maintain code quality, organization, and architecture
Perform code reviews to improve team code writing
Coordinate with Engineering leadership, Product Management, Agile and Design Teams
Coordinate team deployments and setup/maintain CICD pipelines

What You’ll Bring

5 years of experience in hands on Software Development life cycle: Coding, peer reviewing attending production issues.
Minimum 3 years of Management/Technical Lead experience.
Java, REST, SOAP, Performance tuning of Applications.
Prior work experience in and understanding of Agile.
Strong knowledge on CI/CD tools and workflows.
Experience in Agentic AI tooling in the development process preferred but not required
Domain-Driven Design and Micro-service architectures.
SQL Server, NoSQL, ang/or Oracle Databases.
API design
Strong knowledge in Business-Driven Design and Test Driven Development.
Developing middleware applications using a variety of modern technologies with relational, non-relational data bases and cloud hosted applications.
Performance engineering and educating teams on non-functional requirements to achieve web-scale
Middleware and Security experience, fixing vulnerabilities.
A strong background in the PaaS space preferred.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Secure AI agents
jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

Job Summary

We’re building foundational infrastructure to secure AI agents—including their identities, access patterns, and interactions with sensitive systems and data.

This includes designing intelligent, dynamic mechanisms for ephemeral access control, secrets management, and agent and user identity tailored to the

modern agent ecosystem.

As a Principal Engineer, you’ll take ownership of these critical systems, designing and implementing how agents establish identity, receive dynamic access,

securely interact with sensitive systems, and leave verifiable audit trails. You’ll shape the long-term architecture, anticipate technical risks, and evolve

systems that span both machine- and human-facing workflows.

This is a rare opportunity to combine hands-on engineering with technical leadership—writing critical code, mentoring engineers, sharing knowledge, and

driving best practices—while building a platform from the ground up at the cutting edge of AI, identity, and security.

Responsibilities

Own and guide the technical direction of core platform domains, including agent identity, authentication, authorization, and secrets management,
shaping architectures that span multiple services and teams while balancing scalability, reliability, and security.
Lead by example through high-impact implementation, mentoring engineers, and helping them navigate complex technical tradeoffs.
Proactively identify critical technical problems or gaps, and drive solutions from concept through delivery.
Establish and promote engineering best practices, ensuring high standards for code quality, security, and operational excellence.
Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to engineers, architects, product managers, and stakeholders, influencing decisions, fostering
alignment, and driving cross-team collaboration.
Document key decisions, patterns, and practices to elevate team knowledge and ensure consistency across the platform.
Advocate for continuous improvement and operational efficiency, helping the team work smarter while maintaining a secure, high-quality platform.

Qualifications

You bring 8+ years of experience in backend and systems with a track record of owning large-scale or security-critical systems end-to-end.
You’ve designed and operated distributed, cloud-based architectures that are secure, scalable, and reliable, and you’re comfortable working with AWS, GCP, or Azure.
You have experience or a strong interest in identity, authentication, authorization, and secrets management, and you’re excited to apply these principles to AI and agent frameworks—this will give you an edge.
You thrive in ambiguity, make high-impact technical decisions, and guide others through complex tradeoffs with confidence.
You communicate clearly and effectively, influencing decisions, aligning teams, and mentoring engineers across multiple functions.
You’re passionate about sharing knowledge, raising the technical bar, and multiplying the impact of your peers and the team.
You are self-driven, proactive, and organized, with a strong focus on delivering high-quality, secure, and scalable solutions that make a real difference.

What You Will Get

Additional health insurance with dental treatment included
Life / permanent disability insurance
Sick Leave allowance
Mobile phone plan
FLEX Benefits wallet
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

) to join us at Telia.

These applications support order management, logistics, device repair, product catalog, inventory visibility, and planning processes across several Telia markets.

Lead requirement gathering and solution clarification with business stakeholders, product owners, service owners, developers, vendors, and integration partners.

5+ years of experience in .NET/.NET Framework or ASP.NET solution development, including several years in a lead developer, or technical lead role.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer (Booking Integrations)
jobs.description:
About The Team

Breakneck Studio
– an incubator and accelerator scaling digital and e-commerce brands at high velocity. It’s home to our Co-Found program, where ambitious founders take products from zero to market in months, not years. This is where you get hands-on, zero-to-scale experience you won’t find in a regular job.

We are looking

We are a fast-scaling travel startup with strong product-market fit, a generational traveltech company looking to disturb this sleepy industry. We are two-sided: travelers get a consumer product that helps them plan and book trips, and advisors get a SaaS-style subscription with certification and qualified leads in the offer.

We’re looking for the first developers to join a fast-growing travel startup that’s already found strong product-market fit and is now ready to scale.

This is not a role for someone who wants to manage agencies, coordinate stakeholders, or spend weeks building presentations. We’re looking for a builder – someone who can design a schema for breakfast, build a sandbox environment for lunch, load test it before dinner, and wake up excited to get it ready for prod the upcoming week.

You’ll work directly with the founder and early team, own growth from day one, and help shape what the product looks like as the company scales. Work-life balance can look different in a fast-moving company that’s on a mission to make a real impact.

Ready to apply?

Jump to the application form and start your journey with us.

Apply Now

Get ready to

Design, build, and own integrations with third-party booking systems such as suppliers, booking platforms, and partner APIs, covering everything from modern REST/OAuth APIs to legacy SOAP services.
Architect the webhook ingestion and worker queue infrastructure that keeps bookings, availability, and status updates flowing reliably at scale.
Design database schemas in Supabase (PostgreSQL) that model complex booking data cleanly and hold up as volume grows.
Build sandbox and testing environments so integrations can be developed, validated, and debugged safely before they reach production.
Load test and harden services, finding bottlenecks and failure points before customers do.
Take integrations from prototype to production: monitoring, alerting, retries, idempotency, and graceful handling of flaky third-party systems.
Make sure credentials, tokens, and traveler data are handled securely across every integration.
Help evolve our TypeScript, Supabase, and TanStack MVP into a scalable, production-grade platform, and make key architectural decisions along the way.
Work directly with the founder and early team to decide which integrations matter most for travelers and advisors, and ship them fast.
Set the engineering standards, patterns, and practices that future developers will build on as the team grows.

We expect you to

Strong software engineering fundamentals, with deep experience in Authentication & Identity and Backend Software Engineering (PostgreSQL, PHP/Laravel, Node.js/TypeScript).
Expert-level understanding of API authentication across many integration styles, including:
OAuth 2.0 (authorization code, client credentials, PKCE, refresh token rotation) and OIDC
SOAP APIs, including WS-Security, XML signatures and certificate-based authentication
REST API auth patterns such as API keys, HMAC request signing, JWT and mutual TLS

Proven experience designing secure, scalable webhook systems: signature verification, idempotency, replay protection, deduplication, ordering, rate limiting and dead-letter handling.
Hands-on experience building asynchronous job processing with AWS SQS workers, Temporal workflows, or an equivalent durable execution or queue system, including retries, backoff and failure recovery.
Experience integrating with a wide variety of third-party systems, including poorly documented or legacy APIs, and building abstractions that make new integrations faster to add.
Secure handling of credentials and secrets at scale, such as token storage, encryption, rotation and per-tenant isolation.
Strong TypeScript skills, as it is the team’s primary development language.
Solid grasp of engineering best practices, automation and observability, using tools such as Datadog for monitoring and alerting on integration health.
Comfortable in an agile, collaborative environment, communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including external partners’ engineering teams.
Experience leading technical initiatives, influencing architectural decisions or providing technical leadership across teams.

Salary

Gross salary range is 6000-8000 EUR/month + stock options (ESOP) depending on your experience.

Location

We have several great workspaces to choose from, including our headquarters in Vilnius and our hubs in Klaipėda and Riga.

For our Vilnius office, we follow a 4 days onsite, 1 day remote
hybrid model. For roles based outside Vilnius, the work arrangement -onsite, hybrid, or remote-depends on the specific position.

Speaking Of Perks

Own your wellness

Stay sharp and well in your own way – health insurance (after probation), on-site physiotherapist, office gym, and fitness classes keep you moving. Plus 7 extra days off, 3 for weddings, hybrid work, and the freedom to work 2 months from anywhere in the world.

Boost your daily life

Every breakthrough needs a spark and our daily setup reflects that. Pet-friendly office, fresh breakfasts, hot lunches, drawers and fridges stocked with snacks and food – for a quick bite or even a team-cooked meal together. Rooftop and cellar events keep things lively, while 10 social clubs give space to dive into passions and try new things. Add a public transport card for Vilnius and Perks.lt perks for smoother days.

Shape your growth path

Builders never stop learning. Coaching, mentorship, training, conferences, online courses, subscriptions, books – you’ve got a €1000 yearly budget to fuel personal or team growth. You pick the path – we’ll back you all the way.

Drive global impact

This is where ambition scales. Build impact across 30+ brands worldwide. Launch bold projects. Even step in as a co-founder – we reward those who push further. And if you bring in more great people, you get €1500 for every successful referral.

additional conditions apply based on your residence location.

Ready to apply?

Jump to the application form and start your journey with us.

Apply Now
