jobs.title: Solutions Developer
jobs.description:
About Mixvoip
We are Mixvoip, a Luxembourg-based company providing Cloud Telephony, Connectivity, Cybersecurity, and Managed IT Services to businesses and public organizations.
We design, operate, and support many of our solutions ourselves. When we see an inefficient process, a missing integration, or an opportunity to create a better customer experience, we like to build something that solves it.
That’s where you come in.
About the role
You will join Mixvoip’s IT Services team as a Solutions Developer.
Your role sits between software development, infrastructure, automation, and product design.
You will build internal tools that make our teams more efficient, automate repetitive processes, connect systems through APIs, and contribute to customer-facing products.
Projects can be very different from one another. You might build a small automation in Python, a backend service in Rust or C#, a React interface, an integration between several platforms, or a complete solution combining software, infrastructure, authentication, APIs, and physical devices.
We are therefore not looking for someone attached to one specific framework.
We are looking for someone who can understand a problem, choose an appropriate technical approach, prototype quickly, and turn the result into something secure, reliable, understandable, and maintainable.
AI-assisted development is part of how we work. You should be comfortable using coding assistants and development agents such as Codex, Claude, or similar tools to explore codebases, build features, refactor, test, document, and accelerate development.
The important part is not how much code AI can generate for you. It is whether you understand what is being built and remain responsible for the architecture, security, quality, and operation of the final solution.
Key responsibilities
Design and develop internal applications, automation, and operational tools

Contribute to customer-facing products and new commercial solutions

Translate operational or business needs into practical software solutions

Prototype ideas quickly and turn successful prototypes into production-ready systems

Work across technologies such as Rust, Python, C#, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Vite, and similar tools

Build and integrate APIs, webhooks, databases, internal systems, and third-party services

Design frontend, backend, and service components when required

Apply appropriate software architecture and design patterns without unnecessary complexity

Implement authentication, authorization, and secure handling of application data

Write maintainable, testable, and understandable code

Review both human-written and AI-generated code critically

Build automated tests and contribute to CI/CD and deployment processes

Deploy and operate applications in Linux, Windows, containerized, cloud, or on-premises environments

Troubleshoot across application and infrastructure layers, including logs, networking, databases, APIs, permissions, and services

Implement appropriate logging, monitoring, and health checks

Document architecture, dependencies, APIs, deployment procedures, and important technical decisions

Identify manual or repetitive work that could be simplified through software or automation

Work closely with systems engineers, network engineers, support teams, and other colleagues across Mixvoip

What do we need from you?
Strong software development fundamentals

Professional experience building applications, tools, automation, platforms, or software products

Experience with more than one programming language or technology stack

Strong knowledge of at least one backend language such as Rust, Python, C#, or similar

Experience with modern web development using TypeScript, React, Next.js, Vite, or comparable technologies

Good understanding of APIs, HTTP, authentication, webhooks, databases, and system integrations

Good understanding of software architecture and common design patterns

Experience with Git, code reviews, testing, and collaborative development workflows

Good understanding of application security

Good infrastructure fundamentals, including networking, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, operating systems, permissions, and reverse proxies

Comfortable working with Linux and the command line

Familiarity with containers and modern deployment practices

Strong experience using AI coding assistants and development agents in real development work

Ability to review AI-generated solutions critically and recognize when they are incorrect, insecure, or unnecessarily complex

Ability to learn unfamiliar technologies quickly

Good documentation habits

Professional proficiency in English

You do not need to be an expert in every technology we use.
Strong fundamentals, adaptability, and good engineering judgment matter more to us than knowing a specific framework by heart.
What would make you stand out?
Experience with Rust, Python, C#, or .NET

Advanced TypeScript and React experience

Experience building internal tools or operational platforms

Experience turning manual business processes into software and automation

Experience developing customer-facing software products

Experience integrating hardware, meeting room equipment, embedded devices, or IoT systems

Experience with PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Redis, message queues, or event-driven architectures

Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, or infrastructure-as-code

Experience operating applications in both cloud and on-premises environments

Knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SAML, LDAP, Active Directory, or Entra ID

Experience integrating Microsoft 365, Teams, Exchange, calendars, or meeting room technologies

Good understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure and networking

Experience with monitoring, observability, secrets management, and secure software development

Contributions to open-source projects or personal technical projects

French, German, and/or Luxembourgish

Why Mixvoip?
At Mixvoip, you will work on software that solves real problems.
An internal tool might remove hours of repetitive work every week. An integration might eliminate an entire manual process. A prototype might become a product offered to our customers.
You will work close to the people who use what you build, and across telecom, cloud, networking, cybersecurity, managed IT, software, and sometimes hardware.
This also means you can work on a solution end to end: from the initial idea and architecture to the code, infrastructure, deployment, and operation.
We encourage experimentation and rapid prototyping, while expecting production systems to be secure, reliable, and maintainable.
You will have freedom in how you solve problems, together with responsibility for the technical decisions you make.
A new way to apply: Join Mixvoip’s success story
We would like to see more than your CV.
Record a brief video with your smartphone and tell us about something you have built. It can be a commercial product, an internal tool, an automation, a personal project, or something completely different.
Tell us what problem you were trying to solve, how you approached it, and what technical decisions you made.
Please remember to attach your CV in PDF format too.
Instead of a conventional motivational letter, we would also like you to use an AI tool of your choice.
For this role, show us how you use an AI coding assistant or development agent to solve a technical problem. We are interested in how you guide the tool, what you verify yourself, and how you apply your own engineering judgment.
PS: Want to know who you’ll be working with? Meet me, Antoine CAVELIER
I’ve been with Mixvoip for 8 years, and my role is to help businesses make better use of their IT.
With the IT Consulting team, we support customers who often have very different realities. Some have an internal IT department and need a reliable technical partner. Others rely on us for almost everything related to their infrastructure, users, security, cloud services, networks, and day-to-day IT operations.
That variety is what makes this job interesting. One day, you may be working on Microsoft 365. Another day, you may be helping with virtualization, servers, storage, backups, Wi-Fi, Linux systems, scripts, migrations, or a customer project that does not fit neatly into one category.
I like people who are curious, structured, and honest about what they know and what they still need to learn. In consulting, nobody knows everything. What matters is the ability to understand the problem, ask the right questions, investigate properly, communicate clearly, and take ownership until things move forward.
I care a lot about practical solutions. Our customers are SMEs. They need systems that work, advice they can understand, and partners they can trust. Good consulting is not only about technical knowledge. It is also about listening, explaining, documenting, prioritizing, and staying calm when something goes wrong.
I also believe that modern IT work should make good use of the right tools, including AI. Not to replace thinking, but to speed up research, scripting, documentation, troubleshooting, and daily operations.
If you enjoy broad technical challenges, customer contact, autonomy, terminal work, small automation tasks, and the idea of helping many different businesses improve their IT step by step, then you could be a great fit for the team.

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. We are looking for a

Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)

Join our team at our location in Stockholm or Tallinn – hybrid working conditions available.

Our solutions contribute to flexible and customer-friendly payment alternatives. We offer consumers the opportunity to choose when and how they want to pay, whilst guaranteeing a steady and predictable cashflow for merchants. Our products make us proud, but not content and we have high ambitions for our existing as well as upcoming products. We have a strong commitment to building the future of FinTech — human-centric and sustainable. With investments to back it up. Design, develop, test, and ship robust, maintainable, and readable software, applications, APIs, and other workflows
Initiate, participate in, and communicate technical architecture designs
Attend regular scrum ceremonies as a member of an agile cross-functional team
Analyze, discuss, and implement business requirements while maintaining good documentation of the systems and components you create
Bring in industry standards and best practices to continually improve our codebase and architecture
Make a positive impact on our engineering culture by adopting, implementing, and providing feedback on both organisational and industry standards and practices

Qualifications

Hands-on experience with C# and the .NET framework, with a minimum of 5 years of experience
Experience in developing, shipping, and maintaining cloud-based applications
Good knowledge and experience working with microservices and distributed architectures
A deep understanding and knowledge of RESTful APIs

32-40 hours per week, hybrid in Venlo (NL)

As a Junior Software Engineer, you develop applications and system software for our high-end printing products and workflow solutions. A Master’s degree in Computer Science, Informatics or a comparable field
Up to 5 years of professional software development experience
Basic experience with C# and/or Angular/TypeScript through study, internship or work
An interest in embedded systems, microservices and multidisciplinary product development

A proactive approach to learning, problem-solving and taking ownership of your work
Fluent English skills, both spoken and written

A competitive salary in line with your educational background and experience

A huge range of training and professional development opportunities
A laptop and smartphone

A Software Engineer in Test (SET)
, is a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET), is a hybrid role that combines the responsibilities of a software developer with the expertise of a quality assurance (QA) tester. Experience with Grafana and test automation reporting tools (eg. Allure);
At least base understanding REST-based and GraphQL API technologies
Collaboration: Work closely with developers, product managers, and QA to understand requirements and ensure testability.
CI/SD Integration: Integrate automated tests into Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery pipeline (e.g. Jenkins)
Process Improvement: Continuously improve testing processes, tools, and methodologies

Qualifications

Experience with performance testing process, performance testing tools (eg. Nbomber, Jmeter, Locus, K6 etc.), tools and techniques for performance measurement, profiling, and optimization;
DB basic knowledge (MySQL, Firebird);
Playwright experience - big plus
+4 years of experience in test automation or software development

to drive the design, development, testing, and operational excellence of enterprise technology solutions.

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Assistant Vice President
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are Looking For

We are seeking a smart, experienced, and talented individual that takes a service-oriented approach to their work and is passionate about software development and process automation. In this role you will work as part of an agile team of software developers and systems engineers responsible for building, supporting, and enhancing the feature set of our cloud-native technology stack.

Current skills using programming languages/tools for our active code bases are required. These include both Python, and Java ecosystems, web development in Windows and Linux environments.

Proficiency in developing with SQL Server databases is key to this role and strong skills are required.

Candidates must be able to demonstrate proficiency with Git and modern CI/CD software engineering practices.

What You Will Be Responsible For

Development of new processes, services and applications using modern software development languages, tools, and methodologies
Automation, configuration, monitoring and troubleshooting of cloud-based Linux and Windows systems
Collaborate with geographically dispersed, cross-functional teams to streamline workflows
Support business users with technical issues
Identify root causes for technical problems and continuously refine our infrastructure
Define and document workflows and operating procedures for complex systems

What We Value

A successful candidate will be a technical hands-on lead, eager to learn new technologies, skilled in using modern software development tools, familiar with automation techniques, and exceptional at helping people find innovative solutions to challenging problems.
This job is an excellent fit for someone eager to make key contributions in our fast-paced, ever-evolving environment who has a passion for quality, problem solving, and good attention to detail.

Education & Preferred Qualifications

5+ years experience using Sequentum to scrape web content
5+ years experience developing automated extraction of product and pricing information from retailer web sites
multiple years of experience leading a large scale web scraping operation
ability to effectively work with retailer sites in the native languages of 30+ economies across the globe
ability to train and mentor junior developers in scraping technologies, techniques, and policies every few months as new cohorts join the team
highly proficient in English (minimum C-level), with the ability to lead cross-functional collaboration, build strong stakeholder relationships, and drive clear, effective communication across APAC, EMEA, North America, and South America to achieve global business objectives
Master's degree in computer science or information technology (or similar) or equivalent experience
min. 4 years of experience writing software in Python and Java ecosystems (Spring, Maven, JUnit)
min. 4 years of experience with web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, JSON, XML)
experience developing with MS SQL Server databases
familiarity with Linux (bash) and Windows environments (PowerShell)
experience building and deploying systems using Amazon Web Services (AWS)
Proficient with modern software development tools (IDEs, CI/CD, GIT, Jira, Confluence, etc.) and agile (scrum) management practices.

Note:
The role requires a minimum of three days per week working from the office

Minimum Salary

zł182,004 Annual

The minimum salary quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate ultimately works outside of this primary location, the applicable minimum salary may differ.

Salary will be determined based on factors such as the position, type of work performed, individual skills, job description, working hours, diligence, initiative, self-management, length of employment, availability, and the quantity and quality of work delivered, as well as other objective and non-discriminatory criteria relevant to State Street employees.

In addition to salary, employees are eligible to be considered for discretionary annual performance-based awards.

We Offer

Permanent contract from day one
Additional holidays (Birthday Day Off, 3rd and 5th year anniversary Day Off)
Gold Medical Package for employees and their families (partner and children)
Premium life insurance package and private pension plan
Wide range of soft skills training, technical workshops, language classes and development programs
Opportunities to volunteer your time to company-driven initiatives, employee networks or organizations of your choice
Variety of well-being programs
Additional benefits available depending on the seniority of the role

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

new_jobs.description:
Är du redo för en större uppgift? Polismyndigheten är Sveriges största myndighet med ca 42 000 medarbetare över hela landet. Hos oss får du möjlighet att bidra till Polisens uppdrag – att öka tryggheten och minska brottsligheten i samhället.

Organisation
It-avdelningen Kommun
Stockholm Län
Stockholms län Utlyst
5 oktober 2026 Ansök senast
12 oktober 2026 Referensnummer
A599.839/2026

Arbetsplatsbeskrivning

Polisen står inför ett generationsskifte när det gäller kommunikation där vi är på väg mot nästa generations radiokommunikation. Det kommer att ge oss nya kommunikationsmöjligheter med ökad förmåga att dela information i den yttre verksamheten. Som en del av detta arbete behöver vi bygga upp ett nytt utvecklingsteam där du kommer att spela en viktig roll. Ditt arbete kommer att bestå av att tillsammans med vårt team bygga en av de centrala komponenterna för den nya lösningen. Med de nya möjligheterna så behöver vi bygga det som vår verksamhet kräver. Arbetet är innovativt och utforskande i nära samarbete med den operativa verksamheten.

Arbetsbeskrivning

Som backendutvecklare inom Operativa Verksamhetssystem kommer du ha en viktig roll i att skapa verksamhetskritiska och framtidsäkrade system. Du ingår i ett nytt utvecklingsteam som kommer att arbeta med styrning och hantering av Polisens radiosystem, där du bidrar till att lösa komplexa tekniska utmaningar.

Teamet består av erfarna arkitekter och systemutvecklare. Vårt team kommer att arbeta mycket nära andra team som arbetar inom uppdraget. Inom teamet ansvarar vi tillsammans för utveckling och förvaltning av de system vi utvecklar. Systemen driftas i en komplex infrastrukturmiljö med mycket höga krav på säkerhet och tillgänglighet.

Som systemutvecklare ansvarar du för att:

Bygga, testa och förvalta våra egenutvecklade system.
Bygga säkra lösningar med höga tillgänglighetskrav.
Ingå i arbetet för att ta fram lösningar för de krav som ställs på våra system.

Kvalifikationer

Detta är en möjlighet för dig som har:

Relevant utbildning inom systemutveckling alternativt att du har motsvarande förvärvad erfarenhet som Polismyndigheten bedömer som likvärdig.
Minst 5 års aktuell och relevant erfarenhet av att ha arbetat med systemutveckling i .NET eller C++.
Goda kunskaper i svenska.
Svenskt medborgarskap

Det är meriterande om du även har:

Erfarenhet av systemutveckling i TETRA (Rakel).
Erfarenhet av databaser, REST och Git.
Erfarenhet av byggautomation / CI/CD / Jenkins.
Aktuell erfarenhet av arbete med systemintegrationer.
Erfarenhet av Linux.
Erfarenhet av distribuerade system.

Personliga egenskaper

Vi värdesätter att du som person motiveras av att stötta polisen i vårt samhällsviktiga arbete. För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har förmågan att analysera och lösa komplexa tekniska problem effektivt med verksamhetens bästa i fokus. Du har en ambition att driva utveckling som leder till hållbara lösningar.

Då rollen innebär att ni tillsammans tar fram nya lösningar är det viktigt att du trivs med att samarbeta och bidra till gruppens gemensamma mål. Du har en god kommunikativ förmåga, både skriftligt och muntligt, och kan anpassa ditt sätt att kommunicera efter olika målgrupper och situationer.

Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper.

new_jobs.title: Mjukvaruutvecklare / Embedded Software
new_jobs.description:
Etteplan är ett internationellt teknikkonsultbolag med över 4000 specialister globalt. I Sverige arbetar vi nära våra kunder i tekniskt komplexa, ofta långsiktiga uppdrag där mjukvara är affärskritisk. Vi hjälper marknadsledande industriföretag inom exempelvis flyg, fordon, försvar och industriella system att utveckla robusta och framtidssäkra lösningar – i miljöer där kvalitet, tillförlitlighet och ingenjörsmässighet är avgörande. Hos oss är tekniken avancerad, men samarbetet är prestigelöst. Vi tror på tydlighet, förtroende och på kraften i erfarna team som tar ansvar tillsammans.

Vi samarbetar mellan våra kontor och anställer där kompetensen finns. Därför är du välkommen att söka även om du bor på en annan ort än den som anges i annonsen, förutsatt att du kan arbeta från något av våra kontor.

Din roll

Som Mjukvaruutvecklare / Embedded Software
på Etteplan arbetar du i uppdrag där mjukvaran är en central del av helheten – ofta i system med höga krav på stabilitet, säkerhet och livslängd. Projekten kan omfatta allt från låg- och mellanlagernära utveckling till mer systemövergripande ansvar, beroende på din erfarenhet och kundens behov.

Du arbetar nära andra ingenjörsdiscipliner och har en viktig roll i att omsätta krav till hållbara tekniska lösningar. I många uppdrag förväntas du bidra med mer än bara kod – exempelvis genom tekniska resonemang, struktur, mentorskap eller ett helhetsperspektiv på systemet. För dig som vill finns också möjlighet att ta tekniskt ledande ansvar.

Vi rekryterar till flera av våra kontor runt om i Sverige och arbetar huvudsakligen regionalt, med hybridarbete där uppdraget tillåter.

Din profil

För att kunna möta våra kunders behov ser vi att du:

Har ingenjörsutbildning inom datateknik, inbyggda system, elektronik eller motsvarande
Har 3+ års relevant yrkeserfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling, gärna inom embedded
Har god erfarenhet av C/C++, C#, Python och arbete i Linux‑miljö
Är van att arbeta enligt agila arbetssätt och etablerade utvecklingsprocesser
Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift

Det meriterande om du har erfarenhet eller kunskap inom AI, automatiserade byggen och testning, systemsäkerhet eller functional safety.

Många av våra uppdrag bedrivs i reglerade eller säkerhetsklassade miljöer, vilket ställer krav på struktur, dokumentation och professionell kommunikation. Därför söker vi dig som är trygg i din kompetens, arbetar metodiskt och tar ansvar för kvalitet i leveransen. Tjänsten kan innebära säkerhetsprövning enligt säkerhetsskyddslagstiftning, och för vissa uppdrag krävs svenskt medborgarskap.

Att vara konsult hos Etteplan

Som konsult hos Etteplan får du kombinera stabiliteten hos en etablerad arbetsgivare med variationen i olika uppdrag, tekniker och branscher. Du blir en del av ett erfaret ingenjörsnätverk där kunskapsdelning, långsiktighet och kvalitet står i fokus.

Vi erbjuder

Hos Etteplan erbjuder vi trygga anställningsvillkor med kollektivavtal, tjänstepension, försäkringar, vårdförsäkring och friskvårdsbidrag. Du får en flexibel arbetsmiljö med möjlighet till hybridarbete samt stöd från erfarna kollegor och närvarande konsultchefer. Vi värnar om balans i livet och skapar förutsättningar för både professionell och personlig utveckling.

Ansökan och nästa steg

Ansök genom att ladda upp ditt CV och besvara några korta urvalsfrågor. Processen inleds med en telefonavstämning och följs av samtal med konsultchef och vid behov tekniska kollegor.

new_jobs.location: Frederiksberg Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
new_jobs.description:
Basware is a global leader in cloud-based purchase-to-pay and e-invoicing solutions, processing billions of transactions annually for enterprise customers across 100+ countries. With over $300M in ARR and a network connecting hundreds of thousands of buyers and suppliers, Basware sits at the centre of financial automation for some of the world’s largest organisations.

We are now in a pivotal phase of our product evolution — deeply embedding AI and machine learning across the platform to deliver smarter, faster, and more autonomous financial workflows. This role sits at the heart of that transformation.

As Portfolio Architect
you will own the end-to-end architectural vision for Basware’s product portfolio. You will bridge product strategy, engineering delivery, data and AI innovation — ensuring that our platform evolves coherently, scalably, and with AI-first thinking embedded from the ground up.

You will report into senior technology leadership and work in close partnership with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to set technical direction, govern architectural standards, and accelerate the adoption of LLMs, agentic systems, and ML pipelines across the portfolio.

What You'll Do

Architecture Leadership

Define and evolve the portfolio-level technical architecture across Basware’s product suite, ensuring coherence, scalability, and strategic alignment
Set architectural review processes for AI and set engineering standards that span teams and products
Identify architectural risk, technical debt, and opportunities for platform consolidation.

AI/ML Platform Strategy

Lead architectural decisions across LLMs, agentic workflows, vector stores, RAG pipelines, and ML inference infrastructure
Define the approach for integrating AI capabilities into core product flows — from document intelligence to autonomous process automation
Evaluate and select AI tooling and frameworks; build the internal knowledge base around responsible experimentation and production readiness.

MLOps & Governance

Own the MLOps architecture: model training pipelines, versioning, deployment, monitoring, and continuous evaluation
Establish AI governance frameworks covering model quality, explainability, bias detection, data privacy, and regulatory compliance
Drive standardised approaches to model lifecycle management across product teams.

Strategic Partnership

Act as a trusted technical advisor to product leadership, translating architecture decisions into roadmap impact
Represent Basware’s technical direction in customer-facing conversations, analyst briefings, and partnership discussions
Mentor and elevate engineering talent across the organisation; establish communities of practice around architecture and AI.

,

Essential

What We're Looking For

Proven experience as a Solution, Portfolio or Principal Architect at a $300M+ ARR SaaS company
Fluent in using with modern AI tooling and integrating them naturally into spec-driven development, architecture design, technical planning, etc
Demonstrable understanding of AI governance, responsible AI principles, and regulatory considerations (e.g. EU AI Act awareness)
Strong track record of defining and communicating architectural vision to diverse audiences — engineers, executives, and customers
Deep cloud-native architecture experience on AWS or Azure
Excellent written and verbal communication in English; able to produce crisp, persuasive technical narratives

Highly Desirable

Domain experience in fintech, accounts payable automation, procurement, or enterprise financial workflows
Experience with multi-tenant SaaS architecture at enterprise scale
Background in enterprise integration patterns, event-driven architectures, and API-first design
Hands-on expertise in AI/ML engineering — specifically in one or more of: LLMs, agentic systems, vector stores, RAG architectures, and ML pipelines
Practical experience with MLOps tooling and practices (e.g. MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Vertex AI, or equivalent)
Prior experience contributing to or leading architectural governance bodies (e.g. Tech Council, Architecture Review Board)

Location & Ways of Working

This is a remote-first role. We are open to candidates based anywhere in Europe or on the US East Coast (broadly UTC−5 to UTC+2). You should expect to travel to key Basware hubs a few times per year for planning cycles, offsites, and customer engagements.

What We Offer

A high-impact role at the centre of Basware’s AI transformation — with real influence over product direction
Competitive base salary benchmarked to senior architecture talent in your market, plus performance-linked bonus
Remote-first flexibility with a strong, distributed engineering culture
Annual learning & development budget for conferences, certifications, and research

Why Basware?

We’re a purpose-driven company with a global footprint and a collaborative culture. At Basware, you’ll work with passionate professionals, cutting-edge technology, and a shared commitment to innovation and excellence.

Ready to make an impact?

If you're excited by the challenge, apply now and help shape the future of Basware.

new_jobs.title: Sr Staff Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?

At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.

Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.

Summary

At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.

Sequencing has moved genomics from single studies to population scale. Multi-million-sample cohorts, linked phenotypes and multi-omic data are now generated faster than most organizations can analyze them. Our team builds the data platform and the analytical applications that turn these assets into products: a cloud-native lakehouse for genomic and phenotypic data, large-scale statistical genetics pipelines that run reliably at population scale, and the APIs and user interfaces that let scientists ask questions of billions of records and get answers in seconds.

We are looking for a Sr. Staff Software Engineer for this effort in Singapore: someone who can take state-of-the-art analytical methods and turn them into scalable, high-performance, commercial software, and who can work fluently across bioinformatics scientists, cloud infrastructure engineers, and product management. You will work with a globally distributed team, prototyping quickly, demonstrating early, and iterating toward a releasable product.

Responsibilities

Turn advanced statistical genetics methods (for example, genome-wide and phenome-wide association testing for both common and rare variants) from prototypes into high-performance, scientifically accurate, commercially releasable products.
Design and implement analysis pipelines that scale to millions of samples on a cloud-native lakehouse, and establish the standardized, reusable design pattern for low-latency analysis on open table formats at petabyte scale.
Deliver the APIs, web UI and natural-language/agentic query interfaces through which scientific users explore association results and cohort/phenotype data interactively at scale.
Own the operability and unit economics of the platform: orchestrate, monitor, debug and cost-optimize workloads spanning millions of concurrent jobs, designing for fault tolerance and reproducible results.
Partner with bioinformatics scientists, cloud infrastructure teams and product management to translate scientific and customer needs into a product architecture and credible delivery plan aligned with the platform and data business strategy, applying a clear view of what distinguishes a commercial-grade offering from research and open-source community tooling.
Set technical direction and raise engineering standards through design review, mentorship and hands-on contribution, prototyping and iterating rapidly with a customer-first mindset across a globally distributed team.

Requirements

Degree in Computer Science / Engineering / Bioinformatics / Mathematics or a related field.
Demonstrated experience designing and delivering large-scale, data-analysis production software in the cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including containerization (Docker), orchestration, infrastructure automation, and CI/CD.
Strong experience with modern data lake / lakehouse architectures, including open table format internals rather than usage alone: Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake table specifications, catalog services, snapshot lifecycle, partitioning and pruning strategy, compaction, and schema evolution, over columnar storage (Parquet) with distributed query engines (for example Spark, Trino, Databricks).
Solid algorithms and systems engineering foundation, with proven ability to implement performance-critical code in a compiled language such as C/C++, including concurrency, memory management, vectorization and SIMD, and work with columnar in-memory formats and vectorized engines such as Apache Arrow, DuckDB, or Velox.
Proven track record of profiling and optimizing end-to-end systems for runtime, memory, I/O and cloud cost at large scale, and of designing for horizontal scalability.
Proficiency in Python for rapid prototyping, data analysis, and productionized tooling, with familiarity with the scientific and ML/DL library ecosystem.
Experience designing and operating distributed batch and workflow systems that manage very large numbers of concurrent jobs, including metrics, tracing and structured logging, retry, checkpointing and idempotency, and failure triage at million-task scale.
Experience with scientific workflow languages and engines (for example Nextflow, WDL, CWL) and with execution on cloud batch or Kubernetes.
Experience designing and delivering service APIs with an API-first approach: REST or gRPC interface design, versioning and backward compatibility, and multi-tenant access patterns; plus enough full-stack fluency to partner on (or build) modern web front ends and to hold strong opinions on UI/UX for data-heavy scientific applications.
Experience validating numerically and statistically sensitive software: concordance testing against reference implementations, calibration checks, benchmark suites, versioned reference data, and end-to-end reproducibility.
Proven technical leadership and influence at senior level, with strong verbal and written communication skills, and the ability to self-manage and manage interdisciplinary relationships.
Demonstrated experience using AI tooling to plan, manage and accelerate the full software development lifecycle, and to materially increase engineering productivity and quality.

Experience / Education

Sr. Staff Software Engineer: Typically requires a minimum of 12 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 8 years and a Master's degree; or a PhD with 5 years experience; or equivalent experience.

Desired

Working knowledge of statistical genetics and population genomics: genome-wide and phenome-wide association studies, common and rare variant analysis (including gene-based burden and aggregate tests), mixed-model and whole-genome regression approaches, and the standard data formats and quality control practices of the field (VCF/gVCF, PLINK, BGEN, summary statistics, cohort and phenotype definition, ancestry and relatedness handling).
Hands-on experience with genomics-native storage and query stacks such as TileDB / TileDB-VCF, Hail, GLOW, or GenomicsDB.
Experience delivering commercial or clinical-grade genomics or life-science data products, including taking an internal or research tool through to a commercially released product, and a clear understanding of the differences in philosophy, obligations and trade-offs between commercial productization and academic, non-profit or research-community tooling.
Familiarity with techniques for low-latency query over very large result sets: precomputed summary indices, bitmap and zone maps, sketching, and tiered materialization.
Experience building agentic workflows and products, including tool/agent orchestration and MCP-style integrations, over enterprise data; and with machine learning, deep learning or foundation model training applied to genomic or biomedical data.
Experience implementing data governance controls: role-based and row/column-level access, audit trails, tenant isolation, and consent-driven restrictions on data use.
Experience with interactive data visualization for very large result sets, and with modern front-end frameworks.
Cloud cost engineering: cost-per-analysis modelling, spot and preemptible capacity strategy, storage tiering, and egress management.
Be curious, detail oriented, and analytical, with a proven ability to learn quickly.
Be customer-focused, team-oriented, and motivated, taking ownership of assigned tasks and of ambiguous problems.

Listed responsibilities are an essential, but not exhaustive, list of the usual duties associated with the position. Changes to individual responsibilities may occur due to business needs.

We are a company deeply rooted in belonging, promoting an inclusive environment where employees feel valued and empowered to contribute to our mission. Built on a strong foundation, Illumina has always prioritized openness, collaboration, and seeking alternative perspectives to propel innovation in genomics. We are proud to confirm a zero-net gap in pay, regardless of gender, ethnicity, or race. We also have several Employee Resource Groups (ERG) that deliver career development experiences, increase cultural awareness, and offer opportunities to engage in social responsibility. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employment opportunity regardless of sex, race, creed, color, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, military or veteran status, citizenship status, and genetic information. Background check results may potentially result in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment. The background check process and any decisions made as a result shall be made in accordance with all applicable local, state, and federal laws. Illumina prohibits the use of generative artificial intelligence (AI) in the application and interview process. If you require accommodation to complete the application or interview process, please contact accommodations@illumina.com. Junior NetSuite Developer Role Description

This is a full-time, fully remote role for a Junior Developer at MindCloud, an Oracle NetSuite Alliance Partner. You'll support the configuration, customisation, and maintenance of NetSuite solutions for our clients and internal products, working alongside senior developers who'll mentor you from day one.

Your work will span scripting, workflows, and integrations. As well as core NetSuite development, MindCloud builds AI-powered products on top of the platform — including tools that use large language model APIs to automate document processing — so there's real scope to grow into modern web and AI development as you progress. Day to day, you'll help build and modify SuiteScript customisations, troubleshoot system issues, implement enhancements, prepare technical documentation, and take part in testing and deployment.

You'll collaborate closely with consultants, project managers, and end users to understand business requirements and translate them into clean, practical technical solutions. We invest heavily in development: through MindCloud Academy you'll receive structured training, certification support, and continuous mentoring on your way to becoming a skilled NetSuite developer.

What You'll Do

Assist in developing and modifying SuiteScript (JavaScript-based) customisations, workflows, and integrations under the guidance of senior developers.
Build and maintain custom records, fields, forms, roles, and workflows in NetSuite.
Support the development of integrations between NetSuite and external systems and APIs.
Contribute to MindCloud's AI-powered products, including features built on large language model APIs.
Troubleshoot and debug functional and technical issues, and implement small enhancements.
Prepare technical documentation and participate in testing and deployment.
Learn and apply NetSuite development best practices, with openness to feedback and code review.

What We're Looking For

Knowledge of programming fundamentals and at least one scripting language —  JavaScript preferred
, as SuiteScript is JavaScript-based.
Familiarity with web technologies such as  HTML, CSS, and working with REST APIs / JSON
.
Interest in  AI and large language models
, and curiosity about applying them to real business problems (hands-on experience is a plus, not a requirement).
Ability to understand business processes in accounting, finance, or operations and translate requirements into technical specifications.
Foundational exposure to software testing, debugging, and documentation.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organisational skills, with attention to detail.
Effective written and verbal communication, and the ability to collaborate with a remote, cross-functional team.
Motivation to learn NetSuite and cloud ERP technologies, with openness to mentoring.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have

Exposure to SuiteScript, SuiteFlow, or other ERP scripting tools.
Experience with Node.js, Python, or building/consuming APIs.
Any project — academic, personal, or professional — involving AI, automation, or web development.
Prior exposure to ERP systems, SaaS products, or business applications.

What You'll Get

Comprehensive onboarding through MindCloud Academy.
Structured NetSuite training and certification support.
Continuous mentoring from experienced developers and consultants.
Hands-on experience on real client projects and on MindCloud's own AI products.
A collaborative, supportive, fully remote working environment.
Clear career progression towards Developer and Senior Developer roles.

new_jobs.description:
Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive

We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast-track your career.

Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience
Combine ingenuity, in-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence
Advance in-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment

What You’ll Be Part Of

As a Systems Engineer, you will design, build, and own applications and integrations that improve efficiency and effectiveness of the Business Systems in Automotive. The systems you build and work with will solve major business challenges with a focus on Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) & Quality Systems at Harman.

The role is not transactional and not focused on only building and delivering code. It is focused on building Business Solutions based on real Problem Statements with freedom to create fit-for-purpose applications.

You are expected and encouraged to stay on with the latest and greatest technological trends to create value in your designs and in the business application.

This role is well‑suited for an experienced full‑stack software engineer, who is interested in applying Software Engineering and UX Design principles in a low‑code, model‑driven environment and thriving in creating applications with excellent user interfaces.

You will work on business‑critical systems that integrate with PLM, ERP, MES, and Quality platforms, enabling Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and Program teams to manage complex product data in a controlled and traceable way. The problems you will solve are systemic, data‑intensive, and cross‑functional, rather than isolated feature development.

While low‑code platforms (e.g. Mendix for Apps, QLIK for Analytics) are part of the technology stack, this is not a configuration or scripting role. You will apply Object Oriented Programming concepts, data modelling, and architectural thinking to design maintainable, scalable solutions. Low‑code is used to accelerate delivery—not to replace engineering discipline.

In addition, you will leverage Analytics technologies (ex. QLIK) and Database technologies (ex Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, etc.) to build and create complete, well-rounded solutions in partnership with other HARMAN departments.

You will act as a technical owner within the Configuration Management domain, working closely with domain experts and HARMAN Digital IT to ensure that business requirements are implemented as robust, well‑designed systems.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Design and own the Business Architectures on a system / data model level for PLM & Quality
Translate complex business requirements into clear domain models, data structures, and system behavior.
Design and implement custom applications and services using: model driven development concepts, Low code platforms (e.g. Mendix) for rapid delivery of applications, Enterprise systems such as Teamcenter PLM and SAP

Apply software engineering best practices, including modular design, encapsulation, reuse, and lifecycle management.
Define and maintain data models, interfaces, and integrations between PLM, Quality, ERP, and downstream systems.
Act as a technical counterpart to business stakeholders, ensuring solutions are scalable.
Analyze and resolve complex system, data, and process issues using structured root cause analysis.
Drive continuous improvement of Configuration and Change Management processes through system design rather than manual workarounds.
Support Engineering, Manufacturing, and Quality teams in the effective use of CM related systems.
Build deep functional and technical expertise in assigned systems and contribute to migration and integration strategies as platforms evolve.

What Makes You A Strong Fit

Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent professional experience) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline.
3-5 years of professional experience in software development, systems engineering, or enterprise application development.
Strong knowledge of object-oriented programming and design principles
Proficiency in front end technologies (ex. React, HTML & CSS, JavaScript)
Strong Backend Development skills (ex. Node.js, python).
Experience with cloud platforms (ex. Azure)
Proficiency with Git and collaborative development technologies
Experience in system integrations and interfaces, example by using REST API and Microservices architecture
Proven ability to design end-to-end systems, including application logic, data structures, integrations, and building an application for scale.
Desire to learn and work with low-code and analytics platforms as part of a modern enterprise development ecosystem.
Strong analytical skills and a structured approach to problem solving.
Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly in written documentation and technical discussions.
Comfortable working in international, cross-functional teams, with a high level of ownership and accountability.

AIAG Certification
Masters Degree
Experience with Agile Methodologies
Experience with Teamcenter, other PLM Applications, and enterprise systems
Experience with Low Code Platforms (ex. Siemens Mendix)
Experience with Database Technologies (SQL/NoSQL) and Data Lakes (ex. Snowflake, Databricks)
CMII Configuration Management certification (Certified or Professional)
Professional certification in change management / project management
Knowledge and application of continuous improvement philosophies

Be willing to travel up to 10%, domestic and international travel.

What You Can Expect

A hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with in-person collaboration, with most office-based roles onsite three days a week.
Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others)
Learning and development opportunities through our award-winning HARMAN University programs
Wellness benefits designed to support your overall well-being
Tuition reimbursement support
Access to the HARMAN campus fitness center and cafeteria, where available
An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development

,

You Belong Here

You’ll work directly with the founder and early team, own growth from day one, and help shape what the product looks like as the company scales. Work-life balance can look different in a fast-moving company that’s on a mission to make a real impact.

Get ready to

Design, build, and own integrations with third-party booking systems such as suppliers, booking platforms, and partner APIs, covering everything from modern REST/OAuth APIs to legacy SOAP services.
Architect the webhook ingestion and worker queue infrastructure that keeps bookings, availability, and status updates flowing reliably at scale.
Design database schemas in Supabase (PostgreSQL) that model complex booking data cleanly and hold up as volume grows.
Build sandbox and testing environments so integrations can be developed, validated, and debugged safely before they reach production.
Load test and harden services, finding bottlenecks and failure points before customers do.
Take integrations from prototype to production: monitoring, alerting, retries, idempotency, and graceful handling of flaky third-party systems.
Make sure credentials, tokens, and traveler data are handled securely across every integration.
Help evolve our TypeScript, Supabase, and TanStack MVP into a scalable, production-grade platform, and make key architectural decisions along the way.
Work directly with the founder and early team to decide which integrations matter most for travelers and advisors, and ship them fast.
Set the engineering standards, patterns, and practices that future developers will build on as the team grows.

We expect you to

Strong software engineering fundamentals, with deep experience in Authentication & Identity and Backend Software Engineering (PostgreSQL, PHP/Laravel, Node.js/TypeScript).
Expert-level understanding of API authentication across many integration styles, including:
OAuth 2.0 (authorization code, client credentials, PKCE, refresh token rotation) and OIDC
SOAP APIs, including WS-Security, XML signatures and certificate-based authentication
REST API auth patterns such as API keys, HMAC request signing, JWT and mutual TLS

Proven experience designing secure, scalable webhook systems: signature verification, idempotency, replay protection, deduplication, ordering, rate limiting and dead-letter handling.
Hands-on experience building asynchronous job processing with AWS SQS workers, Temporal workflows, or an equivalent durable execution or queue system, including retries, backoff and failure recovery.
Experience integrating with a wide variety of third-party systems, including poorly documented or legacy APIs, and building abstractions that make new integrations faster to add.
Secure handling of credentials and secrets at scale, such as token storage, encryption, rotation and per-tenant isolation.
Strong TypeScript skills, as it is the team's primary development language.
Solid grasp of engineering best practices, automation and observability, using tools such as Datadog for monitoring and alerting on integration health.
Comfortable in an agile, collaborative environment, communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including external partners' engineering teams.
Experience leading technical initiatives, influencing architectural decisions or providing technical leadership across teams.
